# The table-filtering cover recipe checks a `data-field` table cells never render

No curated labels: owned and time-bound. The cover belongs to a featured catalog record, and the examples section is read for the 14.0 gate on Fri Nov 20.

## Context

I found this on 2026-11-17 at 17:41Z while re-shooting the catalog cover that #21184's last criterion asks for, right after #21203 merged (`a2d97b19b8`). The producer of #20679 fails on the merged recipe:

`node buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs --base-url http://localhost:8080 --record table-filtering` → `status: failed`, `expect(locator).toBeVisible() failed … element(s) not found` (15 s).

So that cover cannot be produced. `neomjs/pages` still serves the capture of the earlier example at `resources_pub/website/examples/devmode/table-filtering-14.jpg`.

## The Problem

The recipe's second `after` check is `#myTableFilterContainer .neo-table-body .neo-table-cell[data-field='customer']` with the text "Avery", and it cannot match. The first check (8 rows) passed in the same run. On the live example, after "Avery" is typed into the Customer filter, the table has 8 rows. 8 cells match `.neo-table-cell[id$='__customer']`, and 0 match `.neo-table-cell[data-field='customer']`.

CI does not run the producer, so the recipe merged without ever being run. #21203's Test Evidence shows a capture taken with an earlier version of the recipe.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/grid/Row.mjs:30` documents `data-field` on grid cells, and the 15 grid recipes in `apps/portal/resources/data/example-captures.json` rely on it.
- `src/table/Body.mjs` `getCellId(record, dataField)` builds a table cell's id as `<body id>__<record id>__<dataField>` and renders no `data-field`. `table-filtering` is the only recipe that targets `.neo-table-cell`.

## The Fix

In `apps/portal/resources/data/example-captures.json`, the `table-filtering` recipe's second `after` selector becomes `#myTableFilterContainer .neo-table-body .neo-table-cell[id$='__customer']`. Then the cover is captured and delivered to `neomjs/pages` at the path above.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `node buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs --base-url <dev server> --record table-filtering` passes on the pull request's head, and the pull request states the JPEG's size and sha256.
- [ ] No other recipe changes.
- [ ] Post-merge: a `neomjs/pages` pull request delivers that capture, and the v14 catalog's Table Filtering card shows the table filtered to "Avery".

## Out of Scope

- Giving table cells the grid's `data-field`: that changes the DOM of every table.
- Running the producer in CI.
